The Xiaomi Trimmer Kit Pro is designed for everyday grooming and professional-level results, with self-sharpening stainless steel blades that provide smooth, fast, and precise cutting without pulling hair. It also has 6000 blade motions per minute for efficient performance. The Xiaomi Trimmer has 40 changeable length settings with 0.5mm precision, which are controlled by a smooth rotational dial, enabling for easy styling of various beard lengths and detailed grooming. With different detachable heads and combs, including a nose and ear trimmer, body grooming head, specialty beard combs, and an extra beard comb, the Xiaomi Trimmer Kit Pro can readily adapt to a variety of grooming demands. The Xiaomi Trimmer is powered by a long-lasting 800mAh lithium-ion battery and can provide up to 90 minutes of cordless usage on a single charge, making it suitable for lengthy grooming sessions. Fast charging capability allows for up to 12 minutes of use with a 5-minute charge, while a full charge takes approximately 2 hours using the universal Type-C charging connector. The Xiaomi Trimmer Kit Pro is cordless and corded compatible, giving you versatility at home or on the go. The Xiaomi Trimmer is designed with a sleek matte black finish and an ergonomic body that feels comfortable in your hand and looks great on any tabletop. The trimmer's IPX7 water resistance grade lets it to be completely washable, making cleaning simple and hygienic under running water. The Xiaomi Trimmer Kit Pro has an LED battery status indicator that displays real-time charge levels, allowing customers to be informed, and the travel lock feature prevents inadvertent activation in bags or suitcases.
